note: Both sets are accurate against the page, but Set B captures nearly all symbol definitions (T_Aero, T_Gen, N_Gear, I_Drivetrain, I_Rotor, P0, Delta_Omega, Delta_Omega_dot, theta) plus the negligible aerodynamic-torque-variation assumption with its Region 3 context, while Set A omits most of these. Set A's five claims are all correct but limited to a few symbols and the PID/inverse-proportionality facts. Set B's only weakness is a redundant duplicate of the generator-torque inverse-proportionality claim (listed for both 'generator torque' and 'T_Gen'), which is trivial rather than wrong. Nothing in either set is invented or misbound.
